title: A lightweight macOS app that gives you a clear, browsable view of your Codex and Claude Code skills
description:
Managing agent skills shouldn’t feel like digging through folders — Codex Skill Manager makes it visual, fast, and native. It’s a lightweight macOS app built with SwiftUI that gives you a clear, browsable view of your Codex and Claude Code skills, rendered straight from their SKILL.md files. Instead of juggling directories and ZIP files, you can explore local skills, preview documentation with inline references, and pull new skills directly from Clawdhub — all in one place.
https://github.com/Dimillian/CodexSkillManager
#github #opensource #ai
